newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dec JGB posts hefty losses by end of Tokyo trade.
newsitem.headline: Dec JGB posts hefty losses by end of Tokyo trade.

text.p: Key December Japanese government bond (JGB) futures closed near the day's low in Tokyo, due to long liquidation and large-lot selling by a major U.S. brokerage firm, traders said.

In early trade, traders tried to drive the December up to the record high of 122.65, aided by rumours that Japan's August industrial output may show negative growth of 3.7 percent. Market forecasts centre around minus 1.2 percent growth.
However, the December stopped short of the record and reversed course on a round of long liquidation.
The December ended at 121.95, down from Wednesday's 122.28.
In the morning trade, cash bond purchases led by city banks brought the benchmark yield down to 2.770 percent.
"Cash JGBs have been bought and I think those who had expected the market to be quiet today have been forced to buy back based on the underlying bullish sentiment," said a brokerage trader.
But, in the afternoon, cash bonds eased in sympathy with the futures market.
